reels.title: Opera: A Verbal Critic Framework for Long-horizon Coding Agents

editorial_notes.reasoning: High audience velocity (1.86x) in robotics/TAMP. Addressing the 'critic' problem in coding agents is highly relatable for developers building LLM workflows.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: Why do coding agents get dumber the longer they work, and can a 'verbal critic' fix their mid-project burnout?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A mountain climber receiving corrections from a ground-based guide who only speaks up when the climber is truly veering off-course.
